_readme: Rows added to the vendor workbook, kept separate so the .xlsx stays
pristine and every addition is reviewable in a git diff.
1. Values come from a named, publicly checkable source, recorded in Notes.
2. Where reputable sources disagree, the BROADER range is used. A range
that is too narrow reports healthy people as abnormal, which is the
failure this module exists to prevent.
3. Same four fields and same parsing rules as the workbook sheet, so
These remain BROAD PUBLISHED ADULT ranges, not lab-validated values.
